item.title: Where to watch Alabama vs. Stanford women's soccer: Time, TV channel, live stream for NCAA tournament game
item.description: Where to watch Alabama vs. Stanford women's soccer: Time, TV channel, live stream for NCAA tournament game originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Alabama and Stanford were both ranked in the top 16 of the final regular-season women's soccer poll, but they will meet in a tough second-round NCAA tournament matchup Friday. The Tide, ranked No. 8 but a No. 4 seed in its region, demolished Jackson State 12-0 in its NCAA opener a week ago. Ashley Roni, Larkin Thomason and Melina Rebimbas each had a brace as Alabama posted the second-most goals ever in an NCAA tournament match. That record, incidentally, belongs to Stanford, which scored 15 six years ago against Prairie View to start a national championship run. The Cardinal's tournament opener this year was similarly one-sided in terms of possession but finished with a narrow 2-1 win over Santa Clara. Stanford outshot the Broncos 35-5 and had a 13-0 edge on corners but needed a 75th-minute penalty conversion from Charlotte Kohler to provide the winning margin. Who will prevail on Black Friday and advance to the third round? Here's all you need to know to watch. Where to watch Alabama vs. Stanford women's soccer TV channel: None Live stream: ESPN app Alabama vs. Stanford will not air on a traditional TV channel but fans can stream it live on ESPN+ via the ESPN app . Catch all your favorite ESPN+ action with ESPN Select! Just download the ESPN app, sign in with your ESPN account, tap Subscribe to ESPN Select, and you're set to stream live sports, originals, and more—all in one place. What time is Alabama vs. Stanford women's soccer today? Date: Friday, Nov. 27 Time: 2:30 p.m. ET | 1:30 p.m. CT | 11:30 a.m. PT Alabama vs. Stanford is set to kick off Friday at 2:30 p.m. The game will be played at Dorrance Field in Chapel Hill, North Carolina. item.title: Fury vs Joshua records: How many wins, losses and knockouts does each boxer have?
item.description: This coming month, Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua will finally meet in arguably the biggest clash in the history of British boxing. The ex-heavyweight champions will main event in Cardiff, with millions expected to watch worldwide as Joshua and Fury box after almost a decade of talking. Even with their unbeaten records and titles deserting “AJ” and the “Gypsy King”, interest in the fight has never gone away entirely – even if the contest might’ve been better several years ago . Anthony Joshua during a 2015 stoppage of Dillian Whyte (Getty) Still, the heavyweights will finally clash at long last, with the vacant WBA “Super” belt up for grabs, although bragging rights are the true prize on this occasion. Here’s all you need to know: Tale of the tape: What is each man’s record, height, reach and age? Fury will enter the fight with a 36-2-1 record as a professional, including 25 KO wins. His sole losses were points defeats by Oleksandr Usyk in 2024, following his controversial draw with Deontay Wilder in 2018. The 38-year-old stands at 6ft 9in (although this has been seen as exaggerated throughout his career!) and has a reach of 85in. Meanwhile, Joshua is 30-4 as a pro with 27 KO wins, having lost to Andy Ruiz Jr and Daniel Dubois via stoppage and Usyk on points twice. AJ, 37 years old, is 6ft 6in tall with a reach of 82in. When is the fight? Fury vs Joshua will take place on Friday 11 December. Per a Cardiff Council meeting on 25 November , main-event ring walks will begin at 1am GMT on Saturday (5pm PT / 7pm CT / 8pm ET on Friday). Therefore, the preceding main card could begin any time from 9pm GMT (1pm PT / 3pm CT / 4pm ET). The late start is to ensure a greater US audience. How can I watch it? The event will stream live exclusively on Netflix worldwide. It will be not be a standalone pay-per-view event, meaning it will be available to all Netflix subscribers. item.title: Week 12 in the B1G: Attendance & TV have some big games
item.description: STATE COLLEGE, PENNSYLVANIA - NOVEMBER 21: Clay Thevenin #9 of the Rutgers Scarlet Knights reacts after scoring the game winning 2-point conversion during the fourth quarter against the Penn State Nittany Lions at Beaver Stadium on November 21, 2026 in State College, Pennsylvania. (Photo by Isaiah Vazquez/Getty Images) | Getty Images I bet the folks at FS1 were shaking their heads when they got the Rutgers-Penn State game. Well, it didn’t have the biggest draw on TV but….. First, attendance People are still concerned and talking about attendance at college football. Even at Penn State ; it did not sell out, and that is becoming a major story in Happy Valley. Is bigger not better? While you can’t scroll down from that link, if you read the comments on that post, people are questioning the wisdom of spending $700 million on an expansion/renovation of Beaver Stadium that fans “don’t want and didn’t ask for”. They even posit that they should have spent the $700 million and built a new and smaller stadium! Still, not selling out and still having (allegedly) 106,200 fans in the stands ain’t too shabby. We’ve had readers make comments that Los Angeles is way, way too relaxed to get excited about college football. And we aren’t just talking UCLA not drawing at the Rose Bowl. While not creating huge national attention (other than Lincoln Riley being on the hot seat). USC is a good football team. And, admittedly it was playing a not very good Maryland squad. But it still only drew 53,694 to the Coliseum, recording the lowest percentage capacity of the weekend for the B1G. And playing the defending national champions can cure a lot of ills, it seems. Washington packed the place, cramming in a couple thousand more fans than capacity in its win over the Hoosiers. Oh, and one more time…just because we can and want to. TV Viewership As I wrote above, the folks at FS1 probably were not too excited to get the Rutgers-PSU game. The Nitts were doing okay and Rutgers has been….all too Rutgers. But the last minute of that game has probably been played 17 gazillion times on TV and social media, each time somehow noting that it was FS1. Howya like us now? For these posts, I have been relying on On3’s TV viewership data collection. Nick Schultz does his reporting and it contains the data. This week, though, On3 decided to change its format, making it a tad more challenging to break out information. I know, you’re very upset that I had to think a little more. The Big Ten had the top viewed contest as the Huskers took down tOSU. And despite a lot of troubles on and off the field , Michigan is still Michigan, and playing a Top 10 team can reinforce the stupid numbers that it gets at the Big House….and on TV. Playing in prime time likely boosted the viewership of Oregon-Michigan State. item.title: Reacts poll: Throw it to Bryant more
item.description: DENVER, CO - NOVEMBER 22: Wide receiver Pat Bryant (13) of the Denver Broncos pulls in a catch while cornerback Taron Johnson (3) of the Las Vegas Raiders bears down on Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026, at Empower Field at Mile High in Denver, Colo. (Photo by Timothy Hurst/MediaNews Group/The Denver Post via Getty Images) | Denver Post via Getty Images While Steelers fans are still figuring out WTF just happened with their team in the last five days, Broncos fans are wondering when Pat Bryant is going to become the primary target for Bo Nix. Well, that may be an exaggeration, but Broncos Country does believe No. 13 is the most reliable receiver on a team with a slew of pass-catchers. And the choice wasn’t even close. By a huge margin, Broncos fans think Bryant is one of the best targets for Nix. And by the numbers, they’re not wrong. With just 21 targets, Bryant has caught 16 this season for a total of 221 yards and 2TDs, for a 13.8 average on yards per catch. By comparison, Jaylen Waddle and Courtland Sutton each have more total catches and yards, but the number of drops is much higher. Waddle is 33 of 58 for 398 yards and 2 TDs (12.8 ypc average) and Sutton is 25 of 48 for 266 yards and 2 TDs (10.6 ypc). No wonder only 15% of fans picked Sutton as most reliable and just 1% said Waddle, the receiver who is supposed to be our new super star. Not surprisingly, when Nix is throwing to Bryant his passer rating is gooooooooood . This is wild: Bo Nix has a 146 passer rating when targeting Pat Bryant this year. pic.twitter.com/MoEfU7ATsA — Zac Stevens (@ZacStevens) November 26, 2026 While the Broncos have a lot of receiving targets — and all want the ball — second-year Bryant has earned a few more targets than the rest.

item.title: Cowboys Owner Jerry Jones Sends Brian Schottenheimer Message After Eagles Loss
item.description: The Dallas Cowboys suffered a 39-38 defeat to the Philadelphia Eagles at AT&T Stadium on Thanksgiving . It was their second loss in the last three games despite leading by 21 points. Team owner Jerry Jones send a message about Brian Schottenheimer during his postgame interview. He was promoted to head coach on Jan. 24, 2025, after previously serving as the team’s offensive coordinator. Schottenheimer guided the franchise to a 7-9-1 record in his first year in charge and missed the playoffs for the second straight season. Dallas dropped to 5-7 this campaign and remain in third place in the NFC East. The Eagles are trailing them by half-a-game, while the New York Giants continue to led the division with a 6-3 record. Oct 8, 2026; Arlington, Texas, USA; Dallas Cowboys owner Jerry Jones speaks to the media before the game at AT&T Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Kevin Jairaj-Imagn Images Jerry Jones opens up on potentially replacing Cowboys HC Brian Schottenheimer Jerry Jones made it clear that his team doesn’t plan on making a coaching change soon. He added that the focus should be on the upcoming games. “The game where it was ours to take and we didn’t,” Jones said. “So when you look at every whatever, then you have to question everything… You’ve got to look at everything. And that’s certainly not the thought on my mind at this particular time. We’ve got several more games to go and we’ve got to have our mind on that.” Cowboys owner Jerry Jones says that “nothing we saw out there tonight” gives him confidence in Brian Schottenheimer, but he reiterates that a change is not on his mind right now. https://t.co/BipwLyTsE9 — Nick Harris (@NickHarrisFWST) November 27, 2026 The 84-year-old added that Dallas has a bigger chance of winning with Brian Schottenheimer in charge. “No, I wouldn’t anticipate that,” Jones said . At this juncture, we can give ourselves a better chance to win these coming games, and be where competitive, in my mind, without coaching changes at this time.” The Cowboys have 11 days before they play their next game on Dec. 7. They will visit the reigning Super Bowl champions, the Seattle Seahawks, at Lumen Field in a high-stakes matchup. ABC will broadcast the “Monday Night Football” game live at 8:15 p.m. ET. The post Cowboys Owner Jerry Jones Sends Brian Schottenheimer Message After Eagles Loss appeared first on Gridiron Heroics .

item.title: Freiburg in ecstasy as remarkable winning streak extends to six matches
item.description: Freiburg in ecstasy as remarkable winning streak extends to six matches SC Freiburg head coach Julian Schuster has praised his squad’s extraordinary team spirit following Thursday evening’s dramatic 2-1 Conference League victory over FC Twente. The Breisgauer secured their sixth consecutive competitive victory thanks to a stoppage-time winner from Niklas Beste, with Schuster emphasizing the importance of a united dressing room in navigating a demanding schedule. The Freiburg trainer made six changes to the starting XI that defeated Elversberg 1-0 in the Bundesliga last weekend. Cyriaque Irié rewarded Schuster’s faith by scoring the opener in the 11th minute, but Twente remained the more threatening side for much of the first half and eventually equalized through a Younes Taha free kick in the 62nd. Freiburg nevertheless found another way to win. Substitute Derry Scherhant earned a penalty in the 89th minute, and fellow replacement Beste eventually converted the loose ball after Matthias Ginter’s spot kick struck the post. Schuster explains how Freiburg’s team spirit enables squad rotation Speaking to a group of assembled journalists after the post-match press conference, Schuster drew attention to the collective celebrations following Beste’s dramatic winner. The 41-year-old suggested that the team’s togetherness gives him the confidence to rotate extensively without compromising Freiburg’s competitiveness. “That scene in which the team celebrated together is emblematic of this group,” Schuster told the journalists. “That lends us the strength to rotate the squad with full confidence. One sees this with various clubs that have to deal with extreme pressure during this phase [of the season]. There’s also players who have international obligations. The pressure is extreme. “One really can’t leave anyone out,” Schuster continued. “We have this depth and there’s always little things that leave one needing to switch it up. Then it’s nice when players are ready to serve on a regular basis and not to get caught up in the competition of who makes the team sheet. That’s extremely important and I’m very pleased with the lads who started today and were able to make a contribution to the win.” Schuster’s observations build on his earlier comments concerning Freiburg’s exceptional dressing-room culture . In October, the SC trainer emphasized the importance of protecting the club’s special atmosphere and ensuring that difficult personnel decisions do not undermine the collective. The same philosophy has also been emphasized by Freiburg’s players. Veteran midfielder Maximilian Eggestein recently discussed the importance of sacrificing individual ambitions for the team , while Germany internationals Philipp Treu and Derry Scherhant credited Freiburg’s supportive club culture when reflecting on their own development. item.title: Josh Uche’s Homecoming: How the Miami Native Found His Footing Again with the Dolphins
item.description: Credit: Sam Navarro-Imagn Images For Miami Dolphins edge rusher Josh Uche , the 2026 NFL season has been more than just another stop on a winding professional journey—it has been a long-awaited homecoming. Signed to a one-year contract in March after bouncing across three teams in two years, the 28-year-old Miami native has quietly re-emerged as a reliable, every-down contributor for a rebuilding Dolphins defense. Early Promise and Breakout in New England Drafted by the New England Patriots in the second round of the 2020 NFL Draft out of the University of Michigan, Uche quickly earned a reputation as an explosive, twitchy pass-rush specialist. After battling injuries and adjusting to the pro game over his first two seasons, he exploded onto the scene in 2022. Operating alongside Matthew Judon, Uche racked up 11.5 sacks and two forced fumbles in 15 games, looking every bit like a cornerstone defender for New England’s future. Two Years of Uncertainty However, replicating that 2022 magic proved difficult. Following a three-sack 2023 campaign, Uche re-signed with New England on a short-term deal before being shipped to the Kansas City Chiefs at the 2024 trade deadline. In Kansas City, Uche struggled to crack Steve Spagnuolo’s defensive rotation, appearing in just six games without recording a sack. Seeking a fresh start in 2025, he signed with the Philadelphia Eagles . While he generated solid pressure rates in limited passing-down snaps, he finished the year with just one sack across 12 appearances, leaving his NFL trajectory at a crossroads entering free agency. Reviving His Career in South Florida When Miami brought Uche home in March 2026, the move flew largely under the radar. Initially viewed as a low-cost depth addition to a revamped linebacker room, Uche has outperformed expectations. Through the first 11 weeks of the 2026 season, Uche has already surpassed his combined sack total from the previous two campaigns: Defensive Production: 38 total tackles, 3.0 sacks, 24 total quarterback pressures, and one forced fumble. Expanded Role: Rather than being pigeonholed strictly as a third-down specialist, Uche has logged over 420 defensive snaps and earned strong marks for his run defense—proving he can hold the edge on early downs as well as collapse the pocket. Looking Ahead For a Dolphins squad navigating roster turnover and key injuries during the 2026 campaign, Uche’s steady play has been a bright spot. Returning to the AFC East—and getting the chance to square off against his former Patriots squad twice a year—has given the South Florida product a renewed edge. As Miami enters the final stretch of the season, Uche is making a compelling case that his best football is still ahead of him right in his own backyard. item.title: Joe Milton had Tom Brady losing his mind in comeback win over Cowboys
item.description: ARLINGTON, TEXAS- NOVEMBER 26: Joe Milton #14 of the Philadelphia Eagles celebrates after an NFL football game against the Dallas Cowboys at AT&T Stadium on November 26, 2026 in Arlington, Texas. (Photo by Logan Bowles/Getty Images) | Getty Images Did anyone have Joe Milton becoming a Thanksgiving day legend on your bingo card? That’s exactly what we got on Thursday night as Milton led a miraculous comeback attempt for the Eagles over the Cowboys. Making things even more sweet for Joe? The Cowboys had cut him just several weeks before. Milton, who may actually be the most physically gifted quarterback in the league, had it all on display. The athleticism to extend, the rocket arm, the screw-it-let-it-fly attitude — and it all worked. Tom Brady couldn’t handle it in the booth. The hall of fame quarterback was beside himself in the booth, in awe of what he was witnessing. Tom Brady going crazy in the broadcasting booth on Thanksgiving, a compilation 😂 pic.twitter.com/IgwIq3WFsC — Ari Meirov (@MySportsUpdate) November 27, 2026 Milton finished 21-31 for 331 yards, throwing three touchdowns. He added 15 yards and another touchdown on the ground. DeVonta Smith caught 11 passes for 200 yards and two touchdowns. JOE MILTON GOES DEEP TO DEVONTA SMITH PHIvsDAL on FOX/FOX One/Tubi Stream on @NFLPlus pic.twitter.com/ZcKIPvq6jS — NFL (@NFL) November 26, 2026 317 passing yards 4 total TDs Joe Milton is breaking out in a big way on Thanksgiving 🍗 PHIvsDAL on FOX/FOX One/Tubi Stream on @NFLPlus pic.twitter.com/CExEpE5KDd — NFL (@NFL) November 27, 2026 The flashes have always been there for Milton, he just never has really been able to put all the pieces together. On Thursday, with just a matter of weeks being in the Eagles’ playbook, he did just that. Milton should have the job for the rest of the season with Jalen Hurts done for the season. It’ll be interesting to see if he can keep things going down the stretch. One note — Milton did all of that in front of the nation while repping a Tennessee bracelet. Very cool. Joe Milton wearing a Tennessee Vols wristband on Thanksgiving Day while having the game of his life and leading the Eagles come back from a 21 point deficit. pic.twitter.com/11RBE33jCz — Jordan Moore (@jordanmoore_21) November 27, 2026

item.title: Barcelona could consider selling veteran defender but January move unlikely – report
item.description: Barcelona could consider selling veteran defender but January move unlikely – report Barcelona could consider selling Jules Kounde if a suitable offer arrives, with the French defender’s reduced role under Hansi Flick putting his long-term future at the club under scrutiny, according to The Athletic . It must be remembered that the France international has lost his regular place at right-back to Eric Garcia, prompting Barcelona to reassess his situation ahead of the summer transfer window. However, the outlet clearly mentions that the club is not expected to sanction a January departure and will continue monitoring the defender’s performances over the remainder of the season before reaching a decision. It is quite clear that Barcelona’s defensive recruitment is a top priority, particularly the search for a left-footed centre-back. The club’s ability to complete that signing could depend on generating funds through player sales, making Kounde’s situation increasingly relevant to Deco’s transfer plans, although, as stated before, a January exit for the Frenchman is currently unlikely. Eric Garcia’s rise changes Kounde’s Barcelona future A January move for Jules Kounde is unlikely. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) Kounde has been an important defensive figure since arriving from Sevilla in 2022, but competition for places has intensified under Flick. Garcia’s performances at right-back have strengthened his position in the starting XI, leaving Kounde facing uncertainty over his role. The Frenchman can also operate centrally, but Barcelona’s recruitment plans suggest the club is considering whether his market value could help finance a defensive upgrade. Barcelona need sales to strengthen their defence Notably, Alejandro Balde has also been linked with a possible departure as Barcelona explore ways to create financial room for a new centre-back. However, club sources reportedly indicate that no formal offer has arrived for the left-back. Chelsea are interested in signings Jules Kounde. (Photo by Fran Santiago/Getty Images) Kounde could become another candidate if an attractive proposal emerges. His physical problems have also disrupted his attempts to regain consistency, adding another complication to his position in Flick’s squad. Despite the uncertainty, Barcelona are not expected to force a winter exit. The club will assess his performances and the market before making a decision at the end of the season. Chelsea interested in Kounde’s versatility Kounde continues to attract Premier League attention, with Chelsea among the clubs monitoring his availability . The defender previously rejected the opportunity to join the London side in 2022, choosing Barcelona after leaving Sevilla. Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso reportedly values Kounde’s ability to play both right-back and centre-back, and that versatility could become particularly attractive if Malo Gusto’s future at Stamford Bridge remains uncertain. item.title: Eagles player wasn’t wanted in Dallas. Now he’s getting the last laugh: ‘Packing their bags’
item.description: ARLINGTON, Texas — Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott joked before Thursday’s game that Eagles quarterback Joe Milton was “still a Cowboy” and would help Dallas win. Prescott’s wishes did not come true. Milton crushed the Cowboys and outplayed Prescott, a four-time Pro Bowl quarterback. The Cowboys cut Milton on Aug. 31, and two months later, he left Dallas’ practice squad to join the Eagles’ 53-man roster after Jalen Hurts was diagnosed with blood clots. In his third start with Philadelphia, Milton led the Eagles to a 39-38 comeback victory over the Cowboys at AT&T Stadium, completing 21 of 31 passes for 331 yards with three touchdowns and an interception. He also rushed for a touchdown. “Resilience,” Eagles wide receiver Elijah Moore said of Milton’s performance. “I’m sure that they probably didn’t think the outcome of the game, especially at the end of the game, was going to end up like that. I’m pretty sure that they were probably packing their bags, going inside. And obviously early in the game when it was 31 to 10, they probably thought it was over with. So Joe showed that you never give up. And [if] you continue to sleep [on them], players that you once had are going to come outshine them for another team. And that’s exactly what he showed.” The Eagles looked finished after the Cowboys took a 31-10 lead with 3:40 remaining in the third quarter. But then came Milton. He threw a 45-yard touchdown to DeVonta Smith with 24 seconds left in the third quarter, making it 31-17. He cut Dallas’ lead to eight points (38-30) after rushing for a 15-yard touchdown with 9:17 left in the fourth quarter. On the next drive, he connected with rookie wide receiver Makai Lemon for a 24-yard touchdown to make it a two-point game (38-36) with 2:17 left on the clock. On the Eagles’ last offensive possession, Milton completed two passes to set up Philadelphia’s game-winning field goal. Milton said there was a “lot going through his head” knowing that he was playing against his former team, but he looked unfazed by the moment. Late in the second quarter, the Eagles trailed 21-3 when Milton rolled to his left and threw a 50-yard touchdown to Smith. On that throw, Milton dropped back to the 40-yard line and launched the ball 64.4 yards in the air, the longest touchdown by an Eagles quarterback in the Next Gen Stats era (2016), according to ESPN insights. According to Next Gen Stats, Milton completed 4 of 6 deep passes (20 or more yards) from outside the pocket for 139 yards and three touchdowns, which is the most yards and touchdowns on deep throws in the NGS era. “Heck, yeah, like everybody,” Eagles running back Will Shipley said when asked if he was amazed by Milton’s throws. “Half the time in protection, I’ll look back, the ball will be in the air, and I’m just like, ‘Holy cow.’ I feel like I’m watching it like it’s on TV, but there’s just so much belief in 14 [Joe Milton’s number]. … Everyone in this locker room believes in him as the leader of this team. item.title: Morrison confident Price will 'heal quickly'
item.description: Isaac Price is West Bromwich Albion's top goalscorer in the Championship with seven goals [Getty Images] West Bromwich Albion manager James Morrison is hopeful Isaac Price can return to action ahead of schedule after the midfielder was ruled out for up to six weeks with a knee injury. The 23-year-old came off with an issue in the second half of last Saturday's 2-2 draw at Championship rivals Swansea City . Baggies head coach James Morrison has now confirmed that Price has suffered a grade two medial ligament injury. "He'll be out for roughly six weeks maximum. But, knowing Pricey, he heals quickly," Morrison told BBC Radio WM. "He's a great athlete and a great professional. I'm hoping he'll be a little bit quicker." Coming on top of Mali's Ousmane Diakite being injured on international duty , it leaves Albion light in midfield for Saturday's visit of Bristol City (15:00 GMT) as Rabby Nzingoula misses the game through suspension after being booked in the 3-1 midweek win at Bolton , his fifth yellow card in nine games. "It's something I'll have to speak to him about as three of them could have been avoided," Morrison added. If Price is out for the entire six weeks, he could potentially miss two key encounters with promotion rivals Stoke City, against a meeting with fellow countrymen Ethan Galbraith and Justin Devenny, as well as fixtures against Portsmouth, Cardiff City, Sheffield United, Lincoln City and Preston North End. One option for Saturday is to redeploy left-back Callum Styles, who plays in central midfield for Hungary, but Morrison has also got other options, both short and long term. "It's obvious that we could do with a couple of extras with the injuries that we've had," he added. "But I've not looked into that yet." Latest West Bromwich Albion news, analysis and fan views

item.title: Five Good Texans questions with Jacob Barzilla
item.description: HOUSTON, TEXAS - NOVEMBER 19: C.J. Stroud #7 of the Houston Texans takes the field prior to the game against the Indianapolis Colts at Reliant Stadium on November 19, 2026 in Houston, Texas. (Photo by Kenneth Richmond/Getty Images) | Getty Images I should start by addressing the first obvious question. Yes, Jacob and I are related. One of the few certain things in life is that when I run into a Barzilla, they have to be a relative. In this case, his grandfather and my father are first cousins. I think that makes me a second cousin once removed or some such technical mumbo jumbo. We will just say we are cousins and leave it at that. So, when I saw his name come across my feed as a Texans analysit I was more than a little curious. If you have downloaded the app, you have seen his analysis posted more than once. It looked like interesting analysis and I am probably a little biased. Everyone knows how talented and brilliant the Barzilla’s are. You can find him on Twitter, but also he has gotten started at ESPN Radio 97.5 as a producer in addition to doing some podcasts and some Substack work. We have Baltimore this week, but Baltimore was not interested in doing five questions, so I pivoted to family. Battle Red Blog: A lot has been made of the Texans underachieving their preseason expectations. What do you think are the biggest areas where they have fallen short and do you see it getting better in the last seven games? Jacob Barzilla: I would say the biggest issues have been the defensive regression and late-game execution. They are one of 10 teams in the NFL that are top 15 in EPA/Play on both offense and defense, but the only team that has fewer than 6 wins of that group. Unfortunately, the special teams group getting off to a horrific start didn’t help either. Kai Kroeger had a terrible Week 2 and cost the team points, and the team also struggled in short-yardage situations without Nico Collins. BRB: Even with recent victories there are those that want certain assistant coaches and/or executives let go. Which coaches do you think are on the hot seat and should they be? JB: I don’t think many coaches or executives are currently on the hot seat. Matt Burke is probably out after they stripped away his play-calling and I could see Rod Wright take that spot. Nick Caserio could also be on the hot seat, but I do think the roster is talented and he has drafted well, so I think they will likely give him another season no matter what. BRB: How would you evaluate the job that Nick Caserio has done in building this team? How big a blow to his standing is it to trade a second round pick for a receiver that has barely played? JB: I think Caserio has done a pretty decent job overall, even with the flaws in the run game. Since Nick Caserio took over in 2021, Houston ranks dead last in rushing success rate at just 34.1%. item.title: Dodgers notes: Alex Vesia, Shohei Ohtani, Royce Lewis
item.description: Los Angeles, CA - October 3, 2026: Dodgers pitcher Alex Vesia reacts in the eighth inning during game one of NLDS between the Los Angeles Dodgers and the Atlanta Braves at Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles, CA on Saturday, Oct. 3, 2026. (Eric Thayer / Los Angeles Times via Getty Images) The Dodgers have seen multiple bullpen pieces from their 2026 roster find greener pastures this offseason. It began with Evan Phillips returning to the Atlanta Braves, followed by left-hander Kris Bubic getting $17.5 million from the Cleveland Guardians for the 2027 season on Tuesday. Both right-handers Seth Halvorsen and Ben Casparius underwent Tommy John surgery this offseason and will be unavailable next year. Both Blake Treinen and Alex Vesia remain on the open market, and as for the latter, the New York Yankees have shown interest in his services, per Brendan Kuty and Will Sammon of The Athletic . As the New York Yankees engage with free-agent reliever Adrian Morejon, they have shown interest in fellow lefty reliever Alex Vesia, league sources who spoke to The Athletic on condition of anonymity because they were not authorized to comment publicly said Wednesday. Vesia was one of the most dependable relief options for the Dodgers this past season, posting a 3-1 record with a 2.64 ERA, striking out 74 while walking 32 across 58 innings and posting a 161 ERA+. Shohei Ohtani is not one to shy away from lofty expectations, as he viewed his 2026 season where he posted a sub-2.00 ERA while leading the team in home runs with 30 as a frustrating season, notes Ayako Oikawa of MLB.com . He and the team have reiterated that the two-way superstar will return to his full-time two-way status for 2027. When talking about this offseason, Ohtani was clear about his intent: “I want to make this a good period to make up for this year’s frustration next year.” Royce Lewis wore the no. 23 with the Minnesota Twins, but since that number is being occupied by Kyle Tucker, the newest Dodgers received his blessing from old friend Matt Kemp to don the no. 27. Lewis spoke with David Vasseigh of AM 570 about his conversation with Kemp. “The next text I sent him was ‘I’d be honored to wear your number, because I never thought I’d have the opportunity to be a Dodger…’ He sent a text back in responding. He said ‘Heck yeah! Do it! 100 percent!’” Old friends in new places A pair of former Dodgers relievers have found new homes, as left-hander Charlie Barnes has joined the Atlanta Braves on a minor-league deal, and right-hander Matt Sauer is heading back to the States on a minor-league deal with the Houston Astros. Barnes has received an invitation to spring training, reports Jon Heyman of the New York Post , and Sauer was reassigned to Triple-A Sugar Land, per the transactions tracker on MLB.com . In four games with the Dodgers this season, Barnes posted a 6.30 ERA, striking out five and walking four across 10 innings. item.title: Adeleke sworn in for 2nd term; says ‘Let’s heal our past wounds’
item.description: By Shina Abubakar, Osogbo As Governor Ademola Adeleke took oath of office for his second term tenure, he has charged the Osun State political class to allow the wounds of the past to heal and collaborate to develop the state. Governor Adeleke spoke while addressing hundreds of dignitaries and residents who thronged the Osogbo township stadium to be part of his inauguration. He disclosed that citizens, irrespective of political affiliations, must unite for the collective good. His words: “Fellow citizens, we must heal the wounds of the past and unite for our collective good. I charge the Osun political class to embrace elite consensus, transparency, good governance and local content”. The governor commended the resilience of the citizens and residents of the state to safeguard democracy, saying their commitment has become a national model. “Today is a triumph of the people’s will. I give all glory to God and deeply thank the people of Osun. Their commitment to democracy is today a national model,” he said. 2nd term focus On his administration’s focus for the second term, he said the target of the government will focus on citizens’ welfare, infrastructure expansion, industrialisation, agricultural transformation, digital economy, tourism industry, wealth creation, and youth and women’s development among others. “As growth depends on steady power supply, we will immediately set up the Osun State Electricity Regulatory Commission. This is in line with the power sector law I signed earlier this year. “Job and Wealth creation will be at the heart of our second term. We will establish a digital hub in each of our three senatorial districts. This is to drive job creation in the digital economy. “In education, we will recruit more teachers and speed up school rehabilitation. We will expand bursaries and scholarships, keep tuition affordable, tackle cultism, and revive our technical colleges.” Osun local government crisis On the issue of local government crisis, Adeleke said: “I am glad to announce that Mr President has intervened in the local government matter. In the next one week, the crisis will be fully resolved. Once this is done, our administration will ensure the rehabilitation of the remaining 102 primary health care centres.” Earlier, the deputy governor, Kola Adewusi took oath of office at 11:24a.m. followed by that of the governor whose oath of office was administered by the Chief Judge, Justice Oyebola Adepele-Ojo at exactly 11:34am. Vice President Shettima, Ooni, others Meanwhile, the Vice President, Senator Kashim Shettima led dignitaries from all spheres of life to the inauguration. The National leader of the APC, Chief Bisi Akande; Ondo State Governor, Lucky Aiyedatiwa; former National Secretary of the party, Senator Iyiola Omisore, PDP’s National Treasurer, Prince Diran Odeyemi and former Presidential candidate of the Labour Party, Datti-Baba Ahmed, were also in attendance. item.title: Knicks vs. Heat Prediction: Preview, Injury Report, Advantages, X-Factors
item.description: Mandatory Credit: Bill Streicher-Imagn Images The New York Knicks host the Miami Heat at Madison Square Garden on Friday, November 27, with the defending champions seeking their seventh consecutive victory. Tipoff is scheduled for 7 p.m. ET. The Knicks are 12–6 and third in the Eastern Conference, while the Heat sit sixth at 10–7. New York beat the Cleveland Cavaliers 121–102 on Wednesday, while Miami’s seven-game winning streak ended with a 111–104 loss to the Philadelphia 76ers . There are NBA Cup implications, too. Miami can clinch Group B with a win and a 76ers loss. The Knicks need a victory to avoid elimination. Injury Report Knicks OG Anunoby: Doubtful (Left calf strain) Jordan Clarkson: Questionable (Right plantar fasciitis) Andre Drummond: Questionable (Head injury) Miles McBride: Questionable (Left adductor tightness) Heat Giannis Antetokounmpo: Probable (Right groin tendinitis) Andrew Wiggins: Probable (Right ankle sprain) Why The Knicks Have The Advantage? The Knicks have the stronger defensive foundation. Their 108.3 defensive rating ranks fifth, compared with Miami’s 24th-ranked 116.4. New York ranks eighth in net rating at +6.2 despite a 13th-ranked offensive rating of 114.4. That balance gives the Knicks more ways to survive stretches when shots stop falling. New York also ranks third in rebounding at 46.7 per game and fourth in three-point percentage at 37.4%. Its 14.9 made threes per game rank fourth. Those strengths offer a useful combination: punish defensive breakdowns from outside, then recover enough misses to keep possessions alive. Jalen Brunson leads the offense with 26.1 points, 3.1 rebounds, and 5.9 assists, shooting 42.7% overall and 39.6% from three. Miami cannot afford to let him repeatedly turn the corner and force its big men into difficult help decisions. Karl-Anthony Towns adds 21.2 points, 13.6 rebounds, and 4.2 assists, shooting 54.2% from the field and 41.7% from deep. His ability to pull a big defender away from the basket could create driving lanes for Brunson. Miami’s perimeter defense offers an opening. The Heat allow 15.3 made threes per game, ranking 29th, while opponents shoot 38.4% from deep. New York can exploit that weakness by moving the ball after the initial drive, forcing Miami’s defenders to recover across the floor. Why The Heat Have The Advantage? Miami’s offense is a lot more productive. The Heat rank second in scoring at 119.7 points per game, second in assists at 29.3, and third in free-throw attempts at 28.8. Their 116.8 offensive rating ranks fifth, although their plus-0.4 net rating sits 15th. Antetokounmpo is averaging 28.4 points, 12.7 rebounds, and 5.4 assists on 60.3% shooting. Without Anunoby, New York would have fewer options for absorbing his drives before committing extra defenders. Bam Adebayo contributes 19.1 points, 8.4 rebounds, 3.6 assists, and 2.0 steals, shooting 52.4% overall. item.title: Michigan State vs. Rutgers: Score predictions, analysis from Spartans Wire staff
item.description: Can Michigan State football end the season with a victory over Rutgers? The Spartans Wire staff is here with their thoughts on how this season finale matchup could play out. The Spartans head to Rutgers on Saturday afternoon as favorites in a game for the first time since week two. Michigan State is listed as a field goal favorite in this matchup, with the Spartans needing a win over the Scarlet Knights to avoid finishing in last place in the Big Ten. Both teams come into this matchup with 3-8 records and locked in to missing out on the bowl season this year. The Spartans lost last week against Oregon, while Rutgers stunned Penn State on the final play of the game to snap a four-game losing streak. Kickoff for this matchup is scheduled for 4:15 p.m. ET on Saturday. This game will be televised on Big Ten Network. Let's take a look at our predictions for this week's matchup between Michigan State and Rutgers below: Andrew Brewster Prediction: Michigan State 13, Rutgers 10 The college football world will not exactly be on fire for this one, but winning this is important for Michigan State's culture and future. Robert Bondy Prediction: Rutgers 20, Michigan State 17 It may be a very simple way to look at this matchup, but I'm just not confident in the Spartans' play at quarterback and believe it'll be hard for them to score enough points in this game. This is a battle of bad and injured teams, so it could go either way in this one. I'm going to lean towards the home team in this toss-up game to wrap up the season. Cory Linsner Prediction: Rutgers 16, Michigan State 14 Michigan State might be inspired to end the season on a good note, but this team is just way too beat up to expect a win against a Rutgers team who has seen some good moments recently. item.title: Magnus Bradbury makes first Scotland start in a year against Argentina
item.description: Back-rower Magnus Bradbury will make his first start in a year for injury-hit Scotland in their Nations Championship finals weekend clash with Argentina at Allianz Stadium on Sunday. Head coach Gregor Townsend is unable to call on a string of senior players, including captain Sione Tuipulotu, Ben White, Pierre Schoeman, Scott Cummings, and back-row trio Matt Fagerson, Jack Dempsey and Jamie Ritchie . The absence of Fagerson and Dempsey has paved the way for Edinburgh forward Bradbury, who was not named in the initial squad for this month’s matches, to start in the number eight jersey for the first time since the victory over Tonga last November. The situation in the back-row has been improved by the fact flanker Rory Darge is fit enough to return and captain the side after a shoulder issue forced him to miss last weekend’s win over Japan . Rory Darge is fit enough to return and captain the side (Getty) After Townsend rotated his side heavily for that match, Blair Kinghorn , Kyle Steyn, Huw Jones and Finn Russell return to join Darcy Graham , Rory Hutchinson and Jamie Dobie in a more familiar-looking backline. In the front row, hooker Ewan Ashman returns and is joined by props Rory Sutherland and D’arcy Rae, with key man Zander Fagerson being kept in reserve for a big role off the bench. Gregor Brown and Jonny Gray retain their places together in the second row, while Josh Bayliss joins Darge and Bradbury in the back row, with last weekend’s hat-trick hero Liam McConnell dropping to the bench. George Horne and the versatile Tom Jordan are the two backs listed among the substitutes for a match that will effectively decide who finishes seventh in the inaugural Nations Championship. Scotland XV: 1 Rory Sutherland, 2 Ewan Ashman, 3 D’arcy Rae; 4 Gregor Brown, 5 Jonny Gray; 6 Josh Bayliss, 7 Rory Darge (capt.), 8 Magnus Bradbury; 9 Jamie Dobie, 10 Finn Russell (vice-capt.); 11 Darcy Graham, 12 Rory Hutchinson, 13 Huw Jones, 14 Kyle Steyn (vice-capt.); 15 Blair Kinghorn. Replacements : 16 Seb Stephen, 17 Nathan McBeth, 18 Zander Fagerson, 19 Max Williamson, 20 Liam McConnell, 21 Ollie Leatherbarrow; 22 George Horne, 23 Tom Jordan.

item.title: Ruben Amorim stunned as Omari Hutchinson sparks epic AC Milan Europa League turnaround
item.description: Udinese Calcio v AC Milan - Serie A 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport AC Milan staged a stunning second-half fightback to beat Olympiacos 4-2 in Greece and revive their faltering Europa League campaign. Manager Ruben Amorim was quick to deflect tactical credit after watching one standout winger tear the hosts apart in a blistering 15-minute spell. Hutchinson inspires dramatic turnaround in Greece Hutchinson produced a goal and two assists to power Milan past Olympiacos in a thrilling Europa League clash . The Rossoneri overturned a two-goal deficit to claim a vital victory and keep their European hopes alive. Trailing 2-0 after Mike Maignan's own goal and a superb strike from Jota Silva, Milan looked destined for another damaging defeat. Hutchinson sparked the revival in the 56th minute, picking up possession near halfway, driving forward, cutting inside and firing calmly into the far corner. The winger then set up Alphadjo Cisse for the equaliser seven minutes later before creating the 71st-minute volley that saw substitute Christian Pulisic put Milan ahead. Diego Moreira sealed the 4-2 triumph in stoppage time on a counter-attack involving Pulisic. Amorim hands full credit to Hutchinson Following the final whistle, Amorim played down his own tactical adjustments and insisted Hutchinson's individual brilliance decided the contest. "I didn't change the game," the former Manchester United manager told reporters. "[Goncalo] Ramos came off because he was in pain, so it was a normal substitution. Hutchinson changed the game more than I did. What changed was the first goal." Amorim made it clear that such an influential display came as no surprise, while challenging the winger to maintain his high standards. "I always expect this from him," he added. "He has the potential to do much more. He has talent, like other players in the squad, but it's the head that counts." Milan avoid unwanted European history The victory arrived at a critical moment for the competition favourites, who had lost three of their opening four league-phase fixtures. Conceding twice in Greece also brought an unwelcome milestone, with Opta confirming Milan have now let in at least two goals in three consecutive European matches for the first time in club history. Despite those defensive concerns, Amorim believes the manner of the comeback can serve as a turning point for his squad. "It definitely changes our future," he said. "We did well in the second half, but we made a lot of mistakes again and we have to improve. We have a lot to do to become a very strong team, but the spirit is there. This is the start of something. To believe it, you have to see it. Today we saw that we came back from two goals down and won 4-2. Our confidence will grow." Rossoneri look to build momentum The three points lift Milan to 20th place in the Europa League standings, leaving them on six points from five league-phase matches. item.title: Eagles coach faces backlash for being ‘classless’ and ‘a loser,’ but his players love it
item.description: ARLINGTON, Texas — Eagles coach Nick Sirianni had every reason to be excited after his team overcame a 21-point deficit to beat the Cowboys on Thanksgiving, but many people are upset with how Sirianni conducted himself after the game. After Eagles kicker Jake Elliott made a game-winning field goal to complete the 39-38 win, Sirianni ran over to a group of Cowboys fans in the crowd and rubbed the victory in their faces. He had to be pulled away from the fans before shaking hands with Cowboys players and coaches at midfield. The social media reaction to Sirianni’s celebration has drawn criticism. One of Sirianni’s critics said, “Your team is 4-7, bro. What are you doing?” Sirianni’s answer to that question could be, “I just saved my job today.” Sirianni acted like a man who needed to let loose. Two weeks ago, he appeared to be on the hot seat after the Eagles lost seven consecutive games. But the Eagles have won their last two games and have looked better. If this keeps up, Sirianni’s job is likely safe this offseason. “Excited to celebrate,” Sirianni told reporters about his reaction after the game. “There were a lot of Eagles fans back there. I was excited to celebrate with those Eagles fans and our team. And everything like that. It was fun.” Sure. But what about those Cowboys fans who were sitting there? “I’m sure there were some in there,” Sirianni said. “But at that point, it felt like there were only Eagles fans. We were able to high-five. It was a fun experience there.” Sirianni’s players never stopped fighting after trailing 31-10 late in the third quarter. After quarterback Joe Milton and defensive tackle Ty Robinson made game-changing plays, the Eagles came back to win 39-38 over the Cowboys at AT&T Stadium. It was one of Sirianni’s signature victories during his six seasons with Philadelphia, but he’s not receiving credit for it publicly. Instead, he’s getting ripped on social media platforms like X. Here are a few of the comments: “Nick Sirianni is classless and should not be an NFL head coach. Buddy needs a nap and an ice cream sandwich to go chill out.” “Nick Sirianni doesn’t deserve the wins this team gets. He’s such an embarrassment to NFL coaches. Imagine completing the biggest Thanksgiving Day comeback in NFL history and then running to the SIDELINES to argue with fans!?” “My goodness, Sirianni is such a loser.” The outrage was loud, but Eagles players were not bothered by Sirianni’s actions. They actually liked them. MORE BY CAYDEN STEELE Eagles player compares Nick Sirianni argument to dealing with ‘the drunk uncle’ Nov. 27, 2026, 7:00 a.m. Eagles QB Joe Milton wasn’t wanted in Dallas. Now he’s getting the last laugh: ‘Packing their bags’ Nov. 27, 2026, 6:26 a.m. While playing for the Commanders, Eagles tight end Zach Ertz got into a post-game dispute with Sirianni after the coach talked trash to him. Still, Ertz was happy to reunite with the Eagles this season and play for Sirianni again. “He’s a passionate guy,” Ertz said abo

item.title: “She Should Be the Last Person Complaining About Referees”: NFL Fans React As Patrick Mahomes’ Wife Brittany Blasts Refs Over Controversial Officiating vs. Bills
item.description: Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes greets wife, Brittany Mahomes, during warmups prior to the game against the Washington Commanders at GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium. © Reuters Connect The Kansas City Chiefs’ Thanksgiving Day matchup against the Buffalo Bills went down to the wire. Bills kicker Tyler Bass nailed a 57-yard field goal as the clock expired to seal a 13-10 win. However, shortly before the game-winning field goal, a controversial call against Rashee Rice stopped what could’ve been a promising Chiefs drive with the score tied at 10-10. On a 3rd-and-10 play, Rice leaped to catch a contested ball; however, as he fell to the ground, the ball touched the turf, and after review, the referees ruled it an incomplete pass. After the loss, Patrick Mahomes’ wife, Brittany Mahomes, took to social media to call out the officiating with a scathing message. “HAHAHAHAHA WHAT A JOKE. Guess we can’t even play football without getting it called against us…Not sure what an actual catch is after that I guess?” she wrote on her Instagram story. Fans weren’t too pleased with her calling out the officials. One fan said : “She should be the last person complaining about referees lol.” Patrick Mahomes Makes Thoughts Clear on Nail-Biter Against Bills After suffering their third loss of the season, Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes did not mince words about the team’s effort against a tough road opponent. During his post-game conference, Mahomes said : “I thought we battled through some adversity well, especially defensively. And we played a really good football team down to the wire. Obviously, we made too many mistakes, especially towards the end of the game, but throughout the game, that kind of cost us the victory. At the same time, I thought the guys did a great job of handling the weather, doing their best to kind of get things going, and we just came up short.” The Chiefs boasted a top-10 offense entering this game after dismantling the Arizona Cardinals in a 34-point performance on Sunday. However, the weather combined with a stout Bills defense shut down the team’s aerial attack, with Mahomes accounting for 174 yards. The Chiefs will now face the LA Rams on TNF next week, Dec. 3. item.title: Fury cleared to fight Anthony Joshua despite mental health concerns
item.description: FILE PHOTO - British boxer Tyson Fury celebrates his victory over Ukraine's Vladimir Klitschko after their world heavyweight title bout at the Esprit Arena in Duesseldorf. (is associated with: «Fury cleared to fight Anthony Joshua despite mental health concerns») Rolf Vennenbernd/dpa Tyson Fury has been cleared to fight Anthony Joshua in Cardiff next month despite concerns about his mental health. The British Boxing Board of Control (BBBoC) indicated earlier this week that it would investigate comments from Fury’s wife Paris that the boxer had been diagnosed with schizophrenia, and had the powers to deny him a licence to fight. However, Paris Fury retracted her claim in a statement issued on Thursday night, and the BBBoC’s general secretary Robert Smith told Sky Sports: “Fury cleared last night. All up to date medicals cleared. Promoter told this morning.” Paris Fury said in an initial version of a Netflix documentary due for release today that Fury was diagnosed with schizophrenia just months after beating Wladimir Klitschko to win the world heavyweight title in Dusseldorf in November 2015. She said in Thursday’s statement: “I want to clarify a statement I made in the original version of the Tyson Fury documentary. “I recalled a conversation from many years ago when discussing Tyson’s condition and I used the word ‘schizophrenic’. Whilst Tyson did show some symptoms associated with schizophrenia, he doesn’t have this condition and has never received a diagnosis. “Mental health is complex, and it isn’t always easy to find the right words, especially when you’re living it with someone you love. I’m so proud of Tyson for really opening up in this documentary and want to say thank you for all the support we’ve received as a family.” Netflix indicated it had edited the footage as a result, saying in a statement: “Following new information shared by the family relating to Tyson’s official mental health diagnosis, we have worked alongside them to update the documentary accordingly ahead of launch.” Fury has been open about his mental health struggles since beating Klitschko, after which he took a near three-year hiatus from boxing, with his weight ballooning to 27 stone, while he battled suicidal thoughts and alcohol addiction. Fury admitted hearing “voices in my mind” following his win, adding: “Words can’t explain the darkness I was in. “I came from the living version of the pits of hellfire. And I 100% thought at times I’d end up in a padded room with the door locked, and that scared me so much.”

item.title: Michigan captain Rod Moore seeks one last win in Ohio State rivalry
item.description: ANN ARBOR – For players from Michigan and Ohio, The Game carries additional personal weight, but for Michigan safety and three-time captain Rod Moore, this upcoming game has multiple layers. Moore is from Dayton, Ohio, a little more than an hour’s drive from Ohio Stadium in Columbus, where Michigan and Ohio State will play on Saturday, Nov. 28, for the 122nd time in the series. His career with the Wolverines began in 2021 but was temporarily derailed and extended by a knee injury during spring practice in 2024 that sidelined him that season and for the better part of 2025. He joked with reporters this week that his college career could be a movie or a book. “Yeah, it’s been a lot,” Moore said. Moore is expected to play in The Game between Michigan and Ohio State one last time, although he was listed as “questionable” on the first Big Ten availability lists . “I'm going back home, maybe finishing my Michigan career back at home,” Moore said. “It's very important to me, especially because it's probably not the most even matchup — we both have our share of losses, our share of defeats this year. It's probably going to be the grittiest one I've been a part of, to be honest.” More: Trev Alberts' attorney plans to file lawsuit against Michigan There hasn’t been much national buzz for this matchup as Ohio State, which was ranked No. 1 in the preseason polls, is 7-4 overall, 5-3 Big Ten, and Michigan is 6-5, 3-5. The Wolverines are coming off an 18-16 triple overtime victory over then-unbeaten UCLA last weekend after losing three of the previous four games. Ohio State lost 31-28 at Nebraska, the Buckeyes ’ third loss in four games, sending them out of the College Football Playoff hunt. Michigan won the last two meetings at Ohio Stadium, including a 13-10 upset in 2024 when the No. 2 Buckeyes were three-touchdown favorites. The Buckeyes won last season at Michigan to end the Wolverines’ four-game winning streak in the rivalry. The Wolverines are 10-point underdogs entering this game, but Moore sees a path to upset. Being on the minus side in turnover margin has hindered the Wolverines this season, but they were plus-two in the upset of UCLA, so playing clean and forcing Ohio State turnovers will be key. Michigan’s defense ranks No. 9 nationally and the pass defense, which ranks 17th, will be tested by OSU’s outstanding receiver, Jeremiah Smith . item.title: PSG announce new injury issue to explosive wide player who could miss tomorrow’s game
item.description: PSG announce new injury issue to explosive wide player who could miss tomorrow’s game PSG are flying in terms of results, but the injuries are adding up and there’s increasing strain on the squad each week. If you enjoy PSG Talk coverage and want to see more of it, add us as a preferred source on Google to make us a favourite and see more of our content. Injuries are hitting PSG hard at the moment. Luis Enrique has lost two key attackers in Desire Doue and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, and can now add another regular to the list of players who could miss out tomorrow. The club have just released an injury update ahead of tomorrow’s game against Lorient in Ligue 1. PSG prepare to take on Lorient without another regular starter Julian Finney/Getty Images “Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and Alessandro Longoni are continuing their treatment protocols,” the update stated. “Désiré Doué will undergo surgery in the coming days. Following a muscle strain in his left thigh, Nuno Mendes is undertaking individual recovery work as a precaution.” The Parisians play tomorrow evening, and even if this is the most minor possible injury one imagines the flying full back won’t be risked in a home game against a team in the bottom half of the table. Lucas Hernandez could feature in Mendes’ place. We’ve also seen the versatile Warren Zaire-Emery used on the left when Mendes has been rested. It also potentially means a return to the bench for summer signing Lucas Digne, who was signed as a backup for Mendes but has struggled so far and has been out of the squad in recent games. In other news… PSG drew with Roma in the Champions League this week, their first dropped points of the season. Zabarnyi has taken some harsh criticism for his recent performances from French pundits – but scored the equaliser on Wednesday Luis Enrique hailed his opposite number Gian Piero Gasperini before the draw.

item.title: Fantasy Premier League: Essential FPL tips ahead of GW12
item.description: Fantasy Premier League: Essential FPL tips ahead of GW12 Fantasy Premier League returns for Gameweek 12, so we’re bringing you the best FPL tips on transfers and captaincy ahead of the deadline. FPL Gameweek 11 deadline: Friday, 27th November, 6.30pm GMT The Football Faithful FPL league code: zog9n6 Fantasy Premier League: Essential FPL tips ahead of GW12 Sell Chelsea, buy Liverpool Last week’s column erred on the side of caution when it came to Chelsea, suggesting their players are fine to hold for now until we have more information, both on Joao Pedro’s injury status and their general performance levels. Well, we certainly have more information now. After watching them lose 4-1 to Leeds United at home, the only conclusion we can come to is that Chelsea are a bad team and the reasons for it stretch beyond the availability of Pedro, who still has not returned to training. That’s why I now have no hesitation in recommending you sell Cole Palmer (£9.8m) if he’s in your team. The playmaker has been out of form for weeks now and does not look like being involved in goals at the moment. Over a quarter of FPL managers still own him, which is baffling. Morgan Rogers (£7.9) has similarly looked poor, but he does at least tick along with the odd return. That said, one goal and one assist in his last five Premier League games is nonetheless disappointing. The natural place to look for replacements is Liverpool, who have gradually improved over the past couple of months. Florian Wirtz (£7.5m) has risen twice in price this week on the back of his recent good form, registering two goals and two assists in his last two league games. He’s been quietly very reliable this season, returning in five of his last appearances. I would not rule out Dominik Szoboszlai (£6.7m) as a pick, though. He is not as technically gifted as Wirtz, but he does have more routes to points via set pieces and penalties. Andoni Iraola has evidently landed on a midfield configuration that works and that has benefitted the Hungarian, who has returned in his last two outings. I know there will be a temptation to bring in flashy winger Bradley Barcola (£8.1m), but he is not nearly reliable enough in the final third, especially considering he is more expensive than Wirtz and Szoboszlai. I would not recommend bringing him in yet. Beyond Liverpool, there are several midfielders I would rather own that Chelsea’s this week. Bournemouth’s Marcus Tavernier (£6.8m) has been on fire lately and is great value. Diego Gomez ( £5.1m ) isn’t a sexy pick, but Brighton host Newcastle this Sunday and I could see contributing to a lopsided victory. I even prefer someone like Hull City’s Mohamed Belloumi (£5.2m) , who will face bottom-placed Crystal Palace. Haaland – start, bench or… sell?! After blanking three games in a row, Erling Haaland (£15.7m) dropped in price earlier this week. item.title: Three last-minute Wisconsin football vs. Minnesota predictions
item.description: The Wisconsin Badgers have the chance to end the 2026 campaign on a high note if they are able to take down the Minnesota Golden Gophers and move to 8-4. By no means would it be a storied season that goes down in the record books, but it should be enough to keep Fickell from any more serious conversations about his job security. That being said, all that momentum would cease if Wisconsin were to lose to Minnesota, and knowing how inconsistent Wisconsin has been this season, there aren’t many things you can bank on. However, we take our best cracks at three predictions below. No. 1: Wisconsin loses the turnover battle None of these predictions will come off as hot takes by any means, but perhaps this is the most levelheaded take on this list. On the season, the Badgers sit 80th in turnover margin at -2 against FBS competition. Minnesota, on the other hand, is 14th-best in the nation at a +7 margin. No. 2 Wisconsin’s rushing offense is responsible for each of their touchdowns As previously mentioned, the Badgers are inconsistent this season, and usually when the offense looks like it has something figured out, the next week it falls apart. Well, last week the Badgers’ offense ran for 381 yards across 51 total carries that involved two 100+ yard runners in Colton Joseph and Darrion Dupree. That being said, Minnesota’s pass defense against FBS competition ranks 35th-best in the country, allowing 196.6 yards through the air. Their rushing defense, meanwhile, sits No. 74 in the country at 154.4 yards. If Wisconsin’s offense is productive, it likely comes on the ground. No. 3 The two teams do not combine for 600 yards of total offense All that needs to be said here is that the Badgers and the Gophers each have a top-50 defense against FBS competition (Wisconsin 5th, Minnesota 42nd) while also posting total offenses that rank 118th and 131st. Contact/Follow @TheBadgersWire on X (formerly Twitter) and like our page on Facebook to follow ongoing coverage of Wisconsin Badgers news, notes and opinion. This article originally appeared on Badgers Wire: Three last-minute Wisconsin football vs. Minnesota predictions

item.title: ‘Pure Gaslighting,’ ‘Making Them Up To Protect the Shield’ — NFL Fans Rip League’s Explanation for Overturning Rashee Rice’s Catch in Chiefs-Bills
item.description: ‘Pure Gaslighting,’ ‘Making Them Up To Protect the Shield’ — NFL Fans Rip League’s Explanation for Overturning Rashee Rice’s Catch in Chiefs-Bills The Kansas City Chiefs and Buffalo Bills were tied 10-10 with under two minutes left on Thanksgiving night in Orchard Park when Patrick Mahomes threw to Rashee Rice on third-and-10 deep in Chiefs territory. The officials working the game ruled it a catch, which appeared to give the Chiefs a first down, but the NFL’s replay center in New York overturned it. However, the reversal was only half of it. After Buffalo won 13-10, NFL vice president of instant replay Mark Butterworth explained the ruling to a pool reporter in three answers, and it didn’t take all that long for fans to begin tearing into that explanation. Mark Butterworth Explains Why NFL Overturned Rashee Rice’s Catch The drive had started at the Kansas City 9 at the two-minute mark, and two plays netted nothing before Mahomes went to Rice with 1:51 left. Rice went to the ground with the ball between his right hand and shoulder. After reviewing the play, officials decided he had lost control when his hand moved along the ball as he made contact with the ground. The reversal forced Kansas City into fourth-and-10 deep in its own territory, leaving the Chiefs to punt rather than continue their drive. IMPROVE YOUR TEAM: PFN’s Free Fantasy Trade Calculator Matt Derrick, a Chiefs beat writer, asked Butterworth after the game which requirement of a catch Rice had failed to meet. Butterworth replied , “As the receiver is going to the ground, he had the ball in his right hand, and when he contacted the ground, his hand slid up the ball and we deemed that a loss of control.” Derrick pressed twice more, but Butterworth’s final answer was that “the hand moving up the ball is what we deemed the loss of control.” SET YOUR LINEUPS: PFN’s Free Fantasy Start/Sit Optimizer Fans Aren’t Buying Explanation for Rashee Rice’s Overturned Catch Did that clear anything up? Not for everyone. One fan accused the league of dismissing what viewers believed they had seen, writing , “This is legit just pure gaslighting.” Another fan also took issue with how the explanation was conveyed. “It’s infuriating to just be told so matter-of-factly that we didn’t see what we all definitely saw.” A third fan went further, accusing the league of protecting its own reputation rather than applying the rules consistently. “This is not a misinterpretation of the rule, this is making them up to protect the shield.” The technical explanation was also met with some pushback. Another fan wrote that “Rice’s arm was under the ball while his hand stayed on the ball. The hand and arm had the ball secure against him. The rule is the ball can touch the ground if the ball is still secure, and it was. They only looked at the ball and the hand slightly moving along the ball.” PREDICT THE NFL SEASON: PFN’s Free NFL Playoff Predictor Chiefs head coach Andy Reid was asked about the reversal after the game

item.title: 9 stats from Bills' insane Thanksgiving win: Tyler Bass, James Cook make NFL history
item.description: Tyler Bass made NFL history with his right foot. James Cook ran into elite company. And the Buffalo Bills won a game in which Josh Allen threw two interceptions and didn't account for a touchdown. Buffalo overcame a sloppy offensive performance and miserable weather to beat the Kansas City Chiefs 13-10 on Thanksgiving night, winning on Bass' 57-yard field goal as time expired. The Bills improved to 10-1, extending their winning streak to seven games and maintaining their hold on the AFC's No. 1 seed. Here are nine noteworthy stats from Buffalo's Thanksgiving victory. Tyler Bass became first kicker in NFL history to accomplish feat No NFL kicker has ever done what Bass accomplished Thursday. Bass became the first player in league history to make a game-tying field goal of at least 54 yards and a game-winning field goal of at least 54 yards in the fourth quarter of the same game. He connected from 54 yards with 11:58 remaining to tie the game 10-10. Then, with four seconds left and the game on the line, Bass drilled a 57-yarder as time expired to give Buffalo the victory. He did it in brutal conditions. The temperature was 34 degrees at kickoff, with wind gusts reaching 35 mph and rain falling throughout the night. James Cook joined Terry Allen in exclusive NFL club Cook has been running into the record books almost every week. He carried the ball 32 times for 117 yards and a touchdown against Kansas City. It marked his 10th consecutive game with at least 75 rushing yards and a rushing touchdown, tying Terry Allen for the longest streak in NFL history. Allen accomplished the feat with Washington across the 1995 and 1996 seasons. Bills are 10-1 for first time since 1991 It's been 35 years since the Bills started a season this well. Buffalo improved to 10-1 for the first time since 1991, when the Bills finished 13-3 and reached the second of four consecutive Super Bowls. The Bills have won seven consecutive games since their only loss, a 29-26 defeat against the New England Patriots on Oct. 4. Josh Allen had second-worst passer rating of NFL career Josh Allen was not thankful for the weather. The Bills quarterback completed 10 of 21 passes for 81 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions. His 18.3 passer rating was the second-lowest of his NFL career, surpassed only by a 17.0 rating against the Atlanta Falcons on Jan. 2, 2022. Against Kansas City, both interceptions came inside the 20-yard line. Alohi Gilman picked off a pass intended for Dawson Knox in the end zone during the second quarter. Nohl Williams intercepted Allen again in the third quarter when a screen pass deflected off Khalil Shakir's hands.Allen also rushed for 43 yards on seven carries. Joe Brady joined exclusive company among rookie NFL coaches Joe Brady's first season as an NFL head coach continues to make history. Brady became just the fourth rookie head coach in the Super Bowl era to begin his career with a record of 10-1 or better, and the first since Jim Caldwell started 11-0 w

item.title: Four Keys That Keep Miami Marlins Baseball Alive In 2026
item.description: Credit: Jeff Klein-Imagn Images Thanksgiving week arrives with a mix of gratitude and frustration for Miami fans. The Marlins did not reach the postseason, yet the roster holds enough talent to spark hope for the future. While the standings tell one story, the development of young players tells a much better one. The front office has built a foundation that can support a winning team soon. Baseball is a game of long seasons and hard lessons. This year, the lesson is that Miami has the right people to turn things around. From the dugout to the minor leagues, the signs of progress are clear for those willing to look. The team needs to be thankful for four specific areas that show real promise. Stability From the Ace Sandy Alcantara remains the anchor of the pitching staff when it matters most. He has shown no signs of quitting on a losing effort. Many stars would have demanded a trade or checked out mentally when the team struggled to win. Alcantara chose to stay and lead by example instead. His value goes beyond just throwing strikes on the mound. He acts as a high-road leader in the clubhouse, setting a tone for younger players to follow. This loyalty is rare in modern sports and gives the team a solid core to build upon. Young Stars Rise Up The infield and catching spots have found new life with two breakout performers. Javier Sanoja emerged as a key starter at third base by the second half of the season. He brings great contact skills and the ability to steal bases, making him a threat every time he steps to the plate. His defense is sharp, and he has become a go-to player for the lineup. Catcher Joe Mack arrived at age 23 and made an immediate impact behind the plate. Among the most gifted defensive catchers across the whole game, he surfaced. His performance suggests he will be electric in 2027. The Marlins were right to promote him, and he has become a blessing for the team. Flexibility and Future Arms Griffin Conine offers a different kind of value that often gets overlooked by fans. He is unselfish and willing to play any position the team needs, including first base. His professional attitude allows the manager to move him around without worrying about his reaction. According to Sports Illustrated , Conine said he is “striving to be more consistent.” The minor league system also shows signs of life with pitcher Jacob Kisting. His ability to command the ball and generate swings and misses makes him a top prospect for the future. Kisting could see the majors before the end of 2027 if he continues this path. These four players give the Marlins a clear path forward as the offseason begins. The team has the pitching, the defense, and the mindset needed to compete again soon.

item.title: UK government rejects national consultation on AI datacenters
item.description: The UK government has rejected calls for a UK-wide public consultation on the environmental impacts of AI datacenters, despite a petition attracting more than 39,000 signatures. Campaign group Protect the Wild launched the petition last month, calling for a national consultation that would consider whether further expansion should be restricted, paused, or halted until those impacts are properly understood and addressed. The nonprofit says the petition smashed the 10,000 signature threshold above which a government response is required in just three days, and the total stood at over 39,000 as this article was being prepared. In its response, published on November 23, the government ruled out the requested UK-wide environmental consultation, saying individual projects' impacts should be addressed through the planning process. It pointed instead to a separate consultation on its draft datacenter planning policy, open until January 8, 2027. "Datacenters are vital to the UK's digital economy. They underpin the digital services that people rely on every day, including public services, healthcare and the way people work. They also provide the infrastructure needed to develop and use AI," the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade (BIST) says. "Building more capacity in the UK will support economic growth and innovation, while strengthening national resilience and ensuring the UK is well placed to realize the opportunities presented by AI." But it adds that the government recognizes the environmental impacts of bit barns are real and must be understood and mitigated, and this is one of the reasons why it established the Data Centre Covenant tests. This Covenant, published last month, sets out tests all compute sheds "are encouraged to meet," while "strategic datacenters" are required to meet them to qualify for additional government assistance. The government has yet to define which datacenters qualify as "strategic," saying it will publish further details and eligibility criteria in due course. Qualifying projects could receive help securing power and accelerating planning. Briefly, the Covenant tests are that operators cover any energy costs they create, so that communities do not have to pick up the bill; that they invest in local communities; adhere to the highest environmental standards; create jobs and drive reindustrialization; and provide secure and reliable access to their compute resources. If this has a ring of familiarity, it is because President Trump earlier this year introduced a Ratepayer Protection Pledge , under which hyperscalers and AI companies agreed to protect US consumers from any bill shocks due to the energy and infrastructure requirements of their datacenter projects. It seems that where the US leads, the UK still often follows. The Covenant sets out efficiency targets and reporting expectations, but does not explain how compliance will be enforced or specify penalties for failing to meet its tests. Protect the

item.title: Full list: African countries where travelers can access without visa
item.description: Travelling across Africa is becoming easier as more countries adopt visa-free entry policies aimed at promoting tourism, strengthening regional integration and encouraging trade among African nations. Several African countries have introduced policies allowing citizens of other African countries to visit without obtaining a visa before travelling, reducing the cost and administrative hurdles associated with cross-border movement. Among the countries offering such access are Benin, The Gambia, Rwanda, Seychelles, Ghana and Togo. The policies form part of wider efforts to improve freedom of movement across the continent and advance the African Union’s goal of greater economic integration. The six countries are highlighted below, although their entry arrangements are not identical. 1. Benin Benin is one of Africa’s leading supporters of visa-free movement. It allows citizens of other African countries to enter without obtaining a visa before travelling. The country has promoted easier cross-border movement to encourage tourism, business and regional cooperation. 2. The Gambia The Gambia offers visa-free entry to citizens of other African countries. It is one of the continent’s more open destinations, making it attractive to visitors interested in tourism, business and cultural exchanges. 3. Rwanda Rwanda allows citizens of African Union member states to enter without a visa. The policy supports the country’s efforts to attract African visitors, investors and business travellers. 4. Seychelles Seychelles operates a visa-free entry policy for visitors of all nationalities, including African travellers. However, visitors must obtain the required travel authorisation before departure and meet the country’s entry conditions. 5. Ghana Ghana introduced a free visa policy for African nationals in May 2026. Under the arrangement, African travellers can apply for electronic visas without paying visa fees. However, an application and approval are still required, meaning the policy is not strictly visa-free entry. 6. Togo Togo has introduced visa-free entry for African passport holders, subject to pre-arrival requirements. The policy is part of efforts to facilitate movement across the continent and strengthen regional integration. Vanguard News The post Full list: African countries where travelers can access without visa appeared first on Vanguard News .
